**CSM notes, Petra Nyström, 2026-09-24:**
Delivered the product answer I promised in August, word for word from the head of product: no costed abatement planning in the plan for the next four quarters, no measure library, no curves, no pathway. Scenario comparison is in design, early access for a first group in November (Nordkost is in), no general date. Today: single product what ifs. Tobias asked them not to show early access to the board.

February board paper, four parts: where the number is; which suppliers carry it (12 of 20 on own data); decisions made and possible; the carbon price as the board's question. Draft to Håkan by end of October.

The turn: Staffan (COO) joined late and took Karin's "what happens next" page tiebreak rule straight into his October sourcing review. "Rule first, price later, the rule shows the board what a price would do." Range: 3%. The rapeseed oil pair is within 3% on price. Two close decisions already in October's review. Sent him the Bergstrand policy sentence.

Other two points landed as a split of work: the Spanish suppliers signed by their Spanish buyer (ask for less, in Spanish), site reviews on Staffan's existing visits (six sites, one a quarter). Ulrika coordinates instead of carrying it.

Asked the renewal question. Håkan: "Not today. Today I'd run a process in May." Condition: a February paper the board accepts, and Staffan making three decisions with the rule before then. Top of my actions. Still red, but with a path.

Ulrika remembers four times I've told them about reduction planning. Håkan remembers three.
